hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
неделю = for a week; через неделю = in a week

познакомиться.gloss: to get acquainted, to meet (for the first time)

examples.trans: I dreamed of meeting your friends.

What did you bring into the flat?

проследить.gloss: to see to it, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.
